outcome_wording: PASS = the correction is measured and shipped; what it corrects is the census published earlier the same evening in dl-kb-06-record-archive-crosswave-pointer-layer-20261028, whose counts described a six-wave population.
defect: The register that exists to convict a census which stops seeing a subtree had itself scoped its population by a hand-written tuple of six manifests, all under docs/history. Two tracked waves live in docs/taskpacks and were never opened: docs/taskpacks/20261019-direction/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json and docs/taskpacks/20261023-ui-kb/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json. The script docstring even asserted that a test convicts an undeclared manifest -- no such guard existed.
how_found: A routine audit question after the CI close-out: is "six manifests" the whole family or the family I remembered? Enumerating the tracked population answered it in one command: eight ARCHIVE-MANIFEST/SOURCE-MANIFEST files are tracked, not six. The probe used for that check was itself initially wrong (it read only a top-level `members` key and reported 152 digests against the register's 340), which is the same defect class one level down and is why the shipped guard enumerates from git rather than from any hand-kept list.
